usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Seychelles, consolidated average exchange rates of authorised dealers
usdRate.note: Consolidated average USD mid rate SR 14.6681 on 30 October 2026 (buy 14.5286, sell 14.8347); the World Bank 2025 average was 14.73.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Central Bank of Seychelles, inflation (NBS CPI), September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Year-on-year CPI inflation 1.22% in September 2026 (0.93% in August); the 12-month average was 0.36%. Figures are the National Bureau of Statistics CPI as republished by the CBS.

inflation_projection.note: No published numeric inflation target was found, so we plan with 2.5%, close to the 2021-2025 average of about 2.4%, as the CBS expects inflation to rise from its current low level with higher fuel and food prices.

policy_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Seychelles, press release 30 September 2026 (monetary policy rate for Q4 2026)
policy_rate.note: The Board kept the monetary policy rate at 1.75% for the fourth quarter of 2026 at its 24 September 2026 meeting (release in Seychellois Creole); standing deposit facility 0.25%, standing credit facility 3.25%.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Seychelles, indicative rates on deposits and lending, week of 26-31 October 2026
savings_account_rate.note: Savings rates of the eight listed banks and deposit-taking institutions ranged 1.15-1.60%; median 1.40%. The 2026 Budget Speech gave an average savings rate of 1.39% in December 2025.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Seychelles, indicative rates on deposits and lending, week of 26-31 October 2026
fdr_3m_rate.note: 3-month fixed-term rates ranged 1.10-1.75% across seven institutions; median 1.50%.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Seychelles, indicative rates on deposits and lending, week of 26-31 October 2026
fdr_1y_rate.note: 12-month fixed-term rates ranged 1.25-2.25% across seven institutions; median 2.00%.

dps_rate.note: The CBS weekly indicative rate sheet lists savings, call and fixed-term deposits only; no monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Seychelles
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 2.47% for 2025 (IMF IFS via World Bank). The 2026 Budget Speech gives average savings and fixed-term rates of 1.39% and 3.0% in December 2025.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No retail government savings certificate was found; individuals can buy Treasury bills and bonds through the non-competitive part of CBS auctions instead.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Central Bank of Seychelles, Treasury bill rates, 30 October 2026
tbill_91d_rate.note: 91-day bill 2.30%, 182-day 2.48% and 365-day 2.50% as published by the CBS for 30 October 2026.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Ministry of Finance, press release: issuance of a 5-year Treasury bond, September 2026
tbond_5y_rate.note: Fixed coupon of 3.8% on the 5-year bond auctioned on 7 September 2026 (the June 2026 5-year bond also paid 3.8%); the auction yield was not published.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year Treasury bond was issued in 2026; the longest 2026 issue found was a 7-year bond at a 4.8% fixed coupon (Ministry of Finance, March 2026).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: Seychelles Revenue Commission, Seychelles tax system: withholding tax rates
tax_bank_interest.note: Withholding tax is 5% on interest on current, fixed and call deposits of residents and 0% on savings account interest; withholding tax is a final tax.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No retail government savings certificate exists. For reference, the SRC withholding table taxes Treasury bill interest at 15% for recipients other than financial institutions and insurers; the treatment of Treasury bond coupons was not stated.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme or cover limit was found on the Central Bank of Seychelles website (legislation, financial stability and consumer pages).

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or published typical credit card rate was found; the CBS weekly sheet shows unsecured personal lending at 14.5-21.75% (October 2026) but no card rate.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No usable local equity index; global equity in rupee terms
equity_return_low.note: Low case: weak global equity decade with a stable rupee.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity in rupee terms; after-tax safe rate about 2%
equity_return_base.note: Seychelles has no local stock index with a usable record, so equity means a global index fund in rupee terms, held about 3.5 points above the roughly 2% after-tax safe rate.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity history in rupee terms
equity_return_high.note: High case: strong global equity returns plus some rupee depreciation.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold trend in dollars; rupee about 14.7 per US dollar in October 2026 (CBS)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold prices and a stable rupee.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold trend in dollars; rupee about 14.7 per US dollar in October 2026 (CBS)
gold_return_base.note: Base case: a long-run dollar gold trend of about 4.5% plus about 1% a year of rupee depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Gold trend in dollars; rupee about 14.7 per US dollar in October 2026 (CBS)
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years and faster rupee depreciation.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: CBS: 1-year deposits about 2.0% (Oct 2026, 5% withholding), 365-day bill 2.50% (30 Oct 2026, 15% withholding), 5-year bond 3.8% (Sep 2026)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: mostly savings accounts (about 1.4%, untaxed) and short deposits, allowing for rates to drift lower.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: CBS: 1-year deposits about 2.0% (Oct 2026, 5% withholding), 365-day bill 2.50% (30 Oct 2026, 15% withholding), 5-year bond 3.8% (Sep 2026)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 1-year fixed deposits at about 2.0% after the 5% withholding tax, close to the 365-day bill after its 15% withholding.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: CBS: 1-year deposits about 2.0% (Oct 2026, 5% withholding), 365-day bill 2.50% (30 Oct 2026, 15% withholding), 5-year bond 3.8% (Sep 2026)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: 5- to 7-year Treasury bonds at 3.8-4.8% coupons.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Financial Services Authority publishes insurance statistics but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No regulator or official source publishing indicative term-life premiums per SR 1,000 of cover was found; only company quotes exist.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Public hospital care is free at the point of use; no official figure for the cost of a private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or official source publishing private health insurance premiums by age was found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Seychelles
oop_health_share.note: 28.0% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database), the latest available; older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Inflation assumption 2.5%; NBS health CPI (health prices fell 3.2% year on year in July 2026, via Trading Economics)
goal_inflation_health.note: Public care is free, but private and imported medical costs are planned 1.5 points above general inflation as the recent health CPI is too volatile to use.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: NBS education CPI up 2.49% year on year in September 2026 (via Trading Economics)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices rose about twice as fast as the CPI in 2026, so education is planned 1 point above general inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Seychelles
life_expectancy.note: 76.3 years in 2024 (men 72.1, women 80.7). UN WPP 2024 projects a lower 73.3 years for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 (medium variant) for 2026; totals are the mean of men and women except at 65, where the page gives 15.6.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: Working-age people per person 65+, computed as 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 12.2 in 2025 (World Bank) gives 8.2; 21.0 in 2040 and 44.3 in 2065 (populationpyramid.net/seychelles/2040/ and /2065/) give 4.8 and 2.3.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Seychelles Pension Fund, Age pension (effective 1 January 2025)
retirement_age_default.note: The SPF age pension is payable from 65, with a reduced early pension from 60 if the member stops working. The non-contributory Social Security retirement benefit starts at 63 from 1 January 2026.

retirement_age_government.note: No official statement of the public service retirement age was found.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: CBS: 1-year deposits about 2.0% (Oct 2026, 5% withholding), 365-day bill 2.50% (30 Oct 2026, 15% withholding), 5-year bond 3.8% (Sep 2026)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings accounts and short deposits.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: CBS: 1-year deposits about 2.0% (Oct 2026, 5% withholding), 365-day bill 2.50% (30 Oct 2026, 15% withholding), 5-year bond 3.8% (Sep 2026)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: kept at the after-tax 1-year deposit rate of about 1.9%.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: CBS: 1-year deposits about 2.0% (Oct 2026, 5% withholding), 365-day bill 2.50% (30 Oct 2026, 15% withholding), 5-year bond 3.8% (Sep 2026)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of 5- to 7-year Treasury bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Safe rate about 2%; equity base 5.5%; gold base 5.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case: mostly deposits and Treasury bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Safe rate about 2%; equity base 5.5%; gold base 5.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a balanced mix of bonds, deposits and global equity funds.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Safe rate about 2%; equity base 5.5%; gold base 5.5%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case: a growth-leaning mix with global equity funds.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Ministry of Finance, Budget Speech 2025 (benefit levels from April 2025) and Budget Speech 2026 (SR 800 increase from 1 January 2026)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Social Security retirement benefit (Agency for Social Protection) for someone who also gets an SPF pension above SR 3,250: SR 6,150 from April 2025 (2025 Budget Speech, https://www.finance.gov.sc/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/2025-Budget-Speech.pdf) plus the SR 800 rise from 1 January 2026 (2026 Budget Speech) gives SR 6,950. With an SPF pension below SR 3,250 it is SR 7,200, and with no SPF pension SR 7,450; the Government aims for SR 10,000 by 2029.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Ministry of Finance, Budget Speech 2026 (age of eligibility for Social Security retirement benefit)
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: The age of eligibility was lowered from 65 to 63 on 1 January 2026; the benefit is paid to all eligible residents at three levels depending on their SPF pension (Budget Speech 2025), not by a means test.

gratuity_rule.note: The 2026 Budget Speech covers public-sector service gratuities only; the private-sector rule in the Employment Act (compensation for length of service) could not be read from an official source.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Seychelles Pension Fund, Age pension and FAQ
public_pension_scheme.note: Mandatory for employees (5% employee plus 5% employer contribution, per the SPF FAQ); pension = average adjusted wage x accrual rate (1.21% in 2026) x years of contribution, payable from 65 after 20 years of contributions or the last 10 years continuously; withdrawals carry no tax or fees (SPF FAQ). No automatic indexation of pensions in payment is stated.

savings_account.note: Banks pay about 1.15-1.60% (October 2026); savings interest carries no withholding tax.

fdr_3m.note: About 1.10-1.75% in October 2026; 5% withholding tax on interest.

fdr_1y.note: About 1.25-2.25% in October 2026; 5% withholding tax on interest.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit product with published rates was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No retail government savings certificate; individuals can bid non-competitively for Treasury bills and bonds.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned weekly by the CBS for the Government; individuals with a rupee account can apply.

tbond_5y.note: Issued a few times a year in multiples of SR 1,000; individuals bid non-competitively.

tbond_10y.note: No 10-year Treasury bond was issued in 2026; the longest was 7 years.

equity_fund.note: No locally marketed diversified equity fund for residents was confirmed; investors mainly use foreign funds.

gold.note: Gold is sold mainly as jewellery; no official bullion or coin scheme was found.

oldAgeAllowance.name: Social Security retirement benefit (Agency for Social Protection)

publicHealthCover.name: Ministry of Health (free public health care)
